The founding story & mission

Why did I found OLOMWEB?

The tech scene accumulated a huge volume of quick, shallow introductory content that only skims technology surfaces without reaching their engineering depth, creating a gap between the beginner developer and the engineer capable of running big production projects.

format_quote"Programming is not just writing code that works; it is the art of building systems that withstand time and scale to massive data volumes without sacrificing simplicity and responsiveness."

Engineering philosophy & fields of specialization

Architectural pillars & core domains

My view of development starts from three solid pillars, with deep specialization in modern architectures that combine blazing speed, AI, and proactive security.

clean_hands

Clean & scalable code

Applying SOLID principles and hexagonal architecture to ensure independent business layers and easy swapping of tech components without rewriting the core system.

bolt

Performance-First

Zero resource waste, superb data flow at the Edge, and tools like Astro Islands to strip client bundles for near-zero interface latency.

architecture

Simplicity in architecture

Fighting unnecessary complexity (anti-overengineering). Smart architecture moves less, has fewer points of failure, and is easiest to monitor and diagnose.
